description: IT/OT network segmentation with defined zones and conduits between the enterprise network and the CTC/SCADA and signalling environments
evidence_required: Network architecture diagram, firewall rule exports, zone and conduit register
planned_action: Default deny between IT and OT zones; every boundary exception gets a named owner and an expiry date and reverts automatically

description: Controlled OT remote access through a jump host with MFA and time-limited vendor sessions
evidence_required: PAM session recordings, vendor access request register
planned_action: Remove standing vendor access; time-bound checkout through the PAM jump host with MFA on that path

control_name: OT asset inventory and legacy exceptions
description: OT asset inventory covering unsupported and end-of-life systems, with compensating controls recorded per exception
evidence_required: OT asset register, signed exception register with review dates
planned_action: Complete the OT register and sign an exception with compensating controls for every unsupported component

control_name: Signalling command authentication and integrity monitoring
description: Authentication and integrity monitoring on signalling and interlocking commands
evidence_required: Command audit logs, periodic integrity check reports
planned_action: Introduce command audit logging and scheduled integrity checks on interlocking configuration

description: IoT device authentication and removal of default and shared credentials
evidence_required: Device inventory with credential status, rotation records
planned_action: Unique per-device credentials and a rotation schedule for trackside and onboard sensors

description: Validation of sensor telemetry before it is used for operational or maintenance decisions
evidence_required: Data validation rules, rejected reading logs
planned_action: Plausibility and range checks on telemetry before it reaches the maintenance model

description: Multi-factor authentication on all privileged, remote and administrative access
evidence_required: MFA enrolment report by account type, authentication logs
planned_action: Extend MFA to OT jump hosts and remote vendor access with no exceptions

description: Privileged access management and enforcement of least privilege
evidence_required: PAM vault inventory, standing entitlement reports
planned_action: Bring all database and cloud admin accounts into the PAM vault with time-limited checkout

description: Joiner, mover and leaver process with periodic access recertification
evidence_required: Signed access review records, HR to IT deprovisioning tickets
planned_action: Automated HR-driven JML with quarterly recertification signed by the business owner

description: Role-based access control over the passenger master database
evidence_required: Role definitions, database entitlement matrix
planned_action: Keep RBAC; connect it to the automated JML process so transfers lose access immediately

description: API authentication, object-level authorisation checks and rate limiting
evidence_required: API gateway configuration, authorisation test results
planned_action: Enforce object-level authorisation on every passenger API endpoint

description: Security testing of applications and APIs before release and after major change
evidence_required: Penetration test reports, SAST and DAST output with retest evidence
planned_action: Mandatory SAST/DAST in the release pipeline and an annual penetration test

description: Ticket token and fare payment validation with anomaly monitoring at the gates
evidence_required: Token validation logs, fare anomaly and chargeback reports
planned_action: Dynamic signed QR tokens and anomaly alerts for repeated token use

description: Encryption of passenger data in transit and at rest with managed keys
evidence_required: Cryptographic standard, key management and rotation records
planned_action: Extend field-level encryption to identity records

description: Database activity monitoring with alerting on bulk extraction
evidence_required: Monitoring alert rules, SIEM use case definitions
planned_action: Database activity monitoring on AST-04 with alerts on bulk read volume

description: Secure cloud configuration baselines with drift detection and least privilege IAM
evidence_required: Baseline documents, posture management reports, public access scan results
planned_action: Adopt cloud baselines and posture management covering every region

description: Vulnerability management and patching, with a defined route for OT change windows
evidence_required: Scan reports, patch compliance dashboard, OT possession schedule
planned_action: Risk-based patch SLAs and a possession-linked patch calendar for OT

description: Backups held offline or immutable and separated from production credentials
evidence_required: Backup job reports, immutability settings, credential separation evidence
planned_action: Keep current process; prove recoverability through CTL-19 restore drills

control_name: Restore testing and DR failover exercises
description: Scheduled restoration testing and DR failover exercises
evidence_required: Restore test records with timings, DR exercise reports and findings
planned_action: Quarterly timed restore drill per critical asset; RTO must come from a measured restore

description: AI governance covering model inventory, approved datasets and model change control
framework_refs: NIST AI RMF GOVERN; NIST AI RMF MAP
evidence_required: AI system inventory, model registry, dataset approval records
planned_action: Create an AI governance committee; record the model inventory and baseline the training data

control_name: Model drift monitoring with human review
description: Model drift monitoring with human review of safety relevant maintenance calls
framework_refs: NIST AI RMF MEASURE; NIST AI RMF MANAGE
evidence_required: Drift metrics over time, engineer sign-off records on flagged defects
planned_action: Track drift metrics monthly and require engineer sign-off on every safety-relevant prediction

description: Email filtering, anti-phishing controls and recurring awareness training
evidence_required: Filter configuration, phishing simulation results, training completion rates
planned_action: Keep current controls; report phishing simulation trends to the Risk Committee

description: Security requirements in vendor contracts and assessment before onboarding
evidence_required: Vendor register, contract security clauses, pre-onboarding assessments
planned_action: Security annex and a 24 hour incident notification SLA in every vendor contract; CISO sign-off at onboarding

control_name: Minimum logging standard and SIEM coverage
description: Minimum logging standard across IT, OT and cloud, with periodic SIEM coverage validation
framework_refs: ISO 27001 A.8.15; CIS 8; NIST CSF Detect
evidence_required: Logging standard, log source coverage matrix, quarterly coverage review
planned_action: Onboard OT log sources or place NIDS sensors at the OT boundary; ship flow logs from every cloud region

description: Exercise programme: two tabletop exercises a year from the risk register, a timed restore drill every quarter and one OT-specific exercise a year
framework_refs: ISO 27001 A.5.24; ISO 27001 A.5.30; CIS 17; NIST CSF Respond
evidence_required: Exercise programme schedule, tabletop exercise reports, timed restore drill results
planned_action: Run the first tabletop and restore drill within the first quarter of the roadmap
